Bidders are required to quote their rates strictly in ₹/KG (Rupees per Kilogram). Total quantity = 2500 KG Offers in which the bidder has quoted the rate in any unit other than ₹/KG shall be liable for rejection. (1) PQC : (i) Bidders must be either Manufacturers or Authorized dealer. If bidder is not Manufacturer, t hen he has to submit the valid Authorization certificate directly from Manufacturer. (ii) Offers of those suppliers will be considered who or their Manufacturer has supplied ‘Polyet hylene film / Polyethylene sheet / Polyethylene bags / Plastic film / Plastic sheet / Plastic bag’ of minimum cumulative value Rs.1.71 Lakh in last 5 years from tender opening date. The relev ant proof of supply (Invoice copy / CRAC etc.) to be submitted along with technical offer. Note : Startups and MSE Enterprises (Manufacturer of quoted item) are exempted for above clause of sub mission of proof of supply of prior experience as per govt. guideline. (2) Payment Term: Payments shall be “100% after receipt and acceptance of Material in 90 day s for No n -MSME / in 45 days for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) / in 60 days for Medium Enter prises (MED) as per BHEL, Bhopal norms subjected to Acceptance of Material (SRV) & on-line subm ission of bills (This is in supersession of 10 days’ time as provided in clause 12 of GeM GTC). MSE/MED sellers can avail the intended benefit only if they are manufacturer of offered item (s) an d submi t valid MSE/MED certificate (Udyam / NSIC etc.) along with the offer. Note: Payment will be processed only after reflection of the invoice in GSTR 2A/2B data. (3) Please accept all terms and conditions of GEM bid. (4) Early delivery is acceptable. (5) conflict of Interest as per Annexure-A is applicable for this bid. (6) Any Bidder falling under MSE category shall furnish the following details & submit documentary eviden ce/ Govt. Certificate etc. in support of the same along with their techno-commercial offer I. Type under MSE II. SC/ST Owned III. Women Owned IV. Others (excluding SC/ST & Women Owned) V. Micro VI. Small If the bidder does not furnish the above in the tender, offer shall be processed construing that the bidder is not falling under MSE category. (7) Quantity Variation is ± 5% (8) Test Report: Test report to be provided along with supply. (9) Please submit Annexure-A attached with the bid with Authorized Seal & Sign at each page. (10) Any amount on account of recovery from consigner/supplier under any condition shall be liable to be adjusted against any amount payable to the consigner/supplier against any running bills. (11) Please submit Annexure-A attached with the bid with Authorized Seal & Sign at each page. (12) Inspection Requirements: Inspection after receipt of material at BHEL Bhopal

(13) Please submit Conflict of interest attached in Annexure-A along with the bid . (14) Please submit MII declaration in the format attached in Annexure-A . . 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
